target_logic.opioid_ed: Cases: opioid-use-disorder-related ED presentation identified by ICD-10 F11.xx in ANY of the ten diagnosis columns on qualifying medical claims (event classification priority: opioid ICD/CPT targets before HCG ED). Controls: patients sampled from non-target pool with no opioid-related ICD pattern used for cohort exclusion (5:1 per target within age_band x event_year partition). Labels: is_target_case / target for modeling.
target_logic.non_opioid_ed: Cases: ED (or urgent-care) utilization identified via Milliman Healthcare Cost Group (HCG) line codes (e.g., P51 ER/observation, O11 emergency room, P33 urgent care—see pipeline constants), AFTER excluding every patient who carries an opioid-related ICD in any of the ten diagnosis columns (strict mutual exclusivity with the opioid cohort). Controls: 5:1 random sample without replacement from eligible non-target patients in the same partition; opioid-flagged patients are excluded from this cohort entirely (targets and controls).

exclusion_rules.shared: Gold-layer medical and pharmacy rows are restricted to valid member keys, calendar-year windows, and age imputation bounds used in 2_create_cohort Phase 1. Partitions with zero targets may yield control-only files for training coverage (see pipeline README).
exclusion_rules.opioid_ed: Target pool is defined by configured OUD ICD/CPT logic (default F11 family in all diagnosis positions). Controls cannot be target cases; sampling is without replacement within partition.
exclusion_rules.non_opioid_ed: Any patient with opioid ICD signals across all ten diagnosis columns is removed from BOTH target and control pools for this cohort. ED_NON_OPIOID targets use HCG-based ED/urgent visit classification; balanced 30-day pharmacy lookback applies to feature windows in downstream modeling (per pipeline).
